**Issue #1841 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1841: Patch: the weapon kit: cooldowns, half damage to heroes, Equip from a pick, Float lowers Tribute
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Phase 0 of the Stinkyscape set: a mechanic merged on `main` without the set. No card reaches it until fullsend 1 ships the set; its Stinkyscape cards are built later, in S05, S06.

## The rule

"{has an extra turn cooldown}" (the ability can't be used on the turn after it was); "{deals half damage
to heroes}" (rounded down); Equip straight into a Unit from a Discover, a random pick or a choice of two,
once or twice, without passing through a hand; and "Float reduces Tribute requirement by 1" (each Float
lowers it by 1, never below 0).

## Done when

- The rule is an engine primitive (`crates/engine`), proved on fixture scripts (`crates/engine/tests/rules/fixtures/`, the `testkit`'s `scenario()`), its edges included. No Stinkyscape card is needed or added: the cards come later, behind the set's gate.
- Its §6 row (and §3, §4 or §10 where it touches them), and ruling notes from this issue's block, R(N×1000) up, each named after its proving test (CLAUDE.md rule 3); `cargo jackioh spec index` and `cargo jackioh spec check`.
- A new event has its `ANIMATIONS` and `SOUND_CUES` rows; a new prompt or action is answered by `crates/ai`, the random policy and the timeout, and `legalActions`, the reducer's refusal and the view agree.
- The client's piece, where the mechanic has one, renders `viewFor` alone (CLAUDE.md rule 7).
- New state is optional and skipped when absent, so no shipped game changes: no golden trace moves and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main` names no card that plays differently (plan D3).
- Every number is a named constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9) and the pure crates stay pure (rule 4).
- The gates: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check`, `fuzz --seeds 200`, and the web's typecheck and tests where the client changed.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy/docs/stinkyscape-set.md) (ST3, ST5); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy/JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy` until they merge; where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md).

Part of #1836.
```

# Draft plan for #1841 (planner's notes, run 2)

## Design decided (checked against code)
1. Cooldown: `ActivationCost.extra_turn_cooldown: Option<bool>` (script.rs ~1150; every ActivationCost literal uses `..Default`,
   precedent `either_player` is not a cost either). Record in memory key `"cooldowns"` = `{ <ability id>: { "player": "p1", "turn": <players[p].turns_started at use> } }`
   written in `activate::mark_use` path (activate.rs ~337) only for a cooldown ability. Refusal in `why_ability_unusable`
   (activate.rs ~437) after the uses check: blocked iff `state.active == player && players[player].turns_started == used + ACTIVATE_COOLDOWN_TURNS`.
   R78 reset clears memory (zones.rs reset_instance). View/legal/refusal agree automatically (activation_views_for reads the refusal).
   zh-CN.json entry for the new refusal. Ruling R1841000.
2. Half damage to heroes: `DamageFlagArgs.half_to_heroes` (effects/damage.rs) + `DamageFlags.half_to_heroes` (damage.rs ~58);
   `damage_flags()` lists every field (must add). Applied in `land_hit` hero branch (damage.rs ~466) before Armor: amount / HALF_DAMAGE_TO_HEROES_DIVISOR,
   rounded down; zero-rule `absorbed >= amount_in` must compare with the halved amount. Effect rider, not a card keyword (rejected: keyword
   would halve an Equip host's attacks). Ruling R1841001.
3. Equip from a pick: new `crates/engine/src/effects/equip.rs`: `equip_picks(EquipPicksArgs { query, pick: Discover|Random, offer, times, radiant, prompt })`
   into `self`. Discover opens a PromptKind::Discover whose Resume.hook = `EQUIP_PICK_HOOK` ("@equipPick"), answered through the normal card
   resume path because `work::script_step_for` returns `equip::equip_pick_step()` for that hook (precedent CHAOS_ETERNAL_HOOK, work.rs:643).
   So random casts, Mayor, AI, random policy, timeout need nothing new. Each pick = phantom (`new_instance` in Zone::Gone) fused into host by
   `subsystems::fuse::fuse(FuseArgs{ingredients:[phantom], target:Some(host), radiant_ingredients})` as `play_steps::fuse_equip` does. Ruling R1841002.
4. Float reduces Tribute: new `CardInstance.tribute_mod: Option<i32>` (state.rs ~320, new_instance ~2004), reset by `zones::reset_price` (R766),
   read by `play_choices::tribute_cost_of` (~781): `(printed + tribute_mod).max(0)` only when printed > 0. Trigger `float::float_reduces_tribute(id)`
   (hand + deck trigger, like float_reduces_cost). Ruling R1841003. Regenerates apps/web/src/wire/generated/CardInstance.ts.

## Still to check: testkit verbs, timeout answer, 11-rulings format, fixture index range.
